data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (prior-year closing) was GBP 543.606m. The syndicate reports a gross prior-year improvement (favourable development) of GBP 53.4m relating to underwriting years 2012 and prior, driven principally by favourable claims development (back-year run-off). This improved run-off materially reduced the combined ratio and contributed positively to results; no single dominant recent gross adverse reserve strengthening is disclosed. Several named loss events (aviation losses such as MH17/MH370, maritime and energy losses, Tianjin, space losses and UK floods) are discussed in the Underwriter's Report, but the net quantified prior-year release cited in the technical notes is the headline GBP 53.4m.
raw_causal_phrases: Reassessment of claims outstanding on underwriting years 2012 & prior (2014 - 2011 & prior) resulted in an improvement of GBP 53.4m (2014 - GBP 41.2m).
The performance of the back years have reduced the combined ratio by 11% (2014 - 9%), net of profit commission and other associated expenses.
Favourable run-off of the back years contributed 9.1% to the result

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development of GBP 53.4m taken from the explicit statement in the Claims Outstanding note. The report phrase does not explicitly label this figure as gross or net; it is presented in the technical provisions/claims note and treated here as a gross (insurance liabilities) improvement per the technical note context. Named event amounts are often reported in USD in the Underwriter's Report; where explicit GBP figures were given (UK floods estimate) a GBP value was recorded (approximate midpoint). Claims development triangle used is the gross triangle (figures in GBP '000).
